title: Free Realms Trading Card Game new heroes
names_seen: Free Realms Trading Card Game new heroes

facts.statement: The expansion introduces new heroes of the Realms: a mysterious gypsy and four young heroic characters, who are the only ones who can stand against the Baron.
facts.quote: Sólo un gitano misterioso, cuatro jóvenes heroicos y las cartas más poderosas puede interponerse en su camino!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades? (page body: Conoce a los Nuevos Héroes de Free Realms)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language promotional news item for the Free Realms Trading Card Game announcing a new expansion, with Baron Trampaoscura as its villain, a mysterious gypsy and four heroic young players as the heroes, new in-game items, new card-player quests and power-up cards. The body is mostly marketing copy with no concrete numbers, prices or dates; the posting date is only a relative 'Publicado 2 meses, 6 dias atrás' that cannot be converted to a calendar date from the capture alone.
